The remaining human elements, such as client contact, verifying documents and handling exceptions, limit the score below the maximum.

title: 3314. Statistical, mathematical and related associate professionals (Level 5)
rationale: This role involves data processing, statistical analysis, and reporting, all of which are core domains where AI excels. Because the work is almost entirely digital and relies on structured information, AI tools can automate significant portions of the data manipulation and analytical tasks.

title: 3314 Statistical, mathematical and related associate professionals (Level 4)
rationale: This occupational group covers statistical and mathematical technicians and associate professionals who collect, process, analyze and report numerical data, work that is almost entirely done on computers. Core tasks such as data cleaning, statistical computation, modeling support and report writing are in domains where AI is improving rapidly, and automated analytics tools are already reshaping the role. Limited physical or interpersonal requirements keep the score below the maximum.

title: 332 Sales and purchasing agents and brokers (Level 3)
rationale: This role involves significant digital information processing, communication, and data analysis, all of which are core domains for AI advancement. While human negotiation and relationship management remain important, AI tools are increasingly capable of automating lead generation, market analysis, and routine procurement tasks, leading to high potential for restructuring.

title: 3315 Valuers and loss assessors (Level 4)
rationale: Valuers and loss assessors work largely with documents, data, photos, and market comparables, all of which AI can analyze and draft reports from efficiently, so AI tools are already useful for valuation models and claim assessment. However, the role still requires on-site inspections of property or damage, physical verification, and human judgment and accountability in disputes, which keeps exposure below the highest levels.

title: 3315. Valuers and loss assessors (Level 5)
rationale: Valuers and loss assessors perform knowledge-intensive work involving data analysis, report writing, and regulatory compliance, all of which are highly susceptible to AI automation. While site visits require physical presence, the core analytical tasks and documentation processes are increasingly being streamlined or automated by AI-driven assessment tools.

title: 3321. Insurance representatives (Level 5)
rationale: Insurance representation is a knowledge-based role involving data analysis, communication, and document processing, all of which are highly susceptible to AI automation. While the job requires human relationship management and trust, AI tools are rapidly taking over the core tasks of risk assessment, policy generation, and customer inquiry handling.

title: 3321 Insurance representatives (Level 4)
rationale: Insurance representatives mainly handle policy sales, claims intake, customer advising, and documentation, all of which are largely digital information-processing and communication tasks that AI can increasingly automate, such as drafting quotes, reviewing claims, and answering customer queries. Some human judgment, relationship management, and face-to-face or phone interaction remain, which keeps exposure below the very highest levels.

title: 3323 Buyers (Level 4)
rationale: Buyers (purchasing agents) in Finnish classification 3323 work largely on computers: comparing supplier offers, analyzing prices and market data, negotiating via email and procurement systems, and managing contracts. AI already automates much of sourcing analysis, RFQ processing, and spend analytics, though supplier relationships and negotiation require human judgment.

title: 3322. Commercial sales representatives (Level 5)
rationale: Commercial sales representatives perform significant knowledge work involving communication, data analysis, and CRM management, all of which are highly susceptible to AI-driven automation and augmentation. While the role requires human relationship building and negotiation, AI tools are increasingly capable of handling lead generation, personalized outreach, and administrative tasks, fundamentally reshaping the profession.

title: 3322 Commercial sales representatives (Level 4)
rationale: Commercial sales representatives work largely through communication, proposal writing, CRM updates, and market research, all of which AI can increasingly automate or accelerate. However, the role still depends heavily on relationship building, negotiation, in-person meetings, and trust with customers, which limits full substitution and keeps the exposure in the high-moderate range.

title: 3324 Trade brokers (Level 4)
rationale: Trade brokers (ISCO 3324, Finnish 3324) arrange buying and selling of goods and services, largely through digital communication, documentation, price analysis and contract handling, all of which AI is rapidly improving at. Core value still depends on client relationships, negotiation judgment and trust, which limits full automation, placing exposure in the high range.

title: 3323. Buyers (Level 5)
rationale: Buyers perform predominantly digital knowledge work involving data analysis, contract management, and communication, all of which are highly susceptible to AI-driven automation. While the role requires human negotiation and relationship management, AI tools are increasingly capable of optimizing supply chains, predicting demand, and drafting procurement documentation.

title: 333 Business services agents (Level 3)
rationale: Business services agents primarily perform digital, information-based tasks such as processing transactions, managing client communications, and administrative coordination. Since these core functions are highly susceptible to automation through AI-driven workflow tools and natural language processing, the occupation faces significant restructuring.

title: 3331 Clearing and forwarding agents (Level 4)
rationale: Clearing and forwarding agents mainly handle customs declarations, shipping documents, tariff classification, and communication with carriers and authorities, which are largely digital document-processing tasks that AI can increasingly automate. Some work still involves physical goods inspection, coordinating transport in real time, and client relationships, which limits exposure somewhat.

title: 3324. Trade brokers (Level 5)
rationale: Trade brokers perform predominantly digital knowledge work involving market analysis, communication, and data processing, all of which are highly susceptible to AI-driven automation and decision-support tools.
